name: Investment Fund
definition: Distinct pool of financial instruments managed by a single investment policy. May or not be part of an umbrella fund. The pool is issued in at least one investment fund class.

FundType.name: Fund Type
FundType.definition: Legal form of the fund, eg, UCITS, SICAV, OEIC, Unit Trust, and FCP.

Structure.name: Structure
Structure.definition: Structure of the subfund, eg, single fund, multi-class.

LegalForm.name: Legal Form
LegalForm.definition: Legal form of a fund, eg, corporation or trust.

SubFundIndicator.name: Sub Fund Indicator
SubFundIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the investment fund is a subfund, when it is a compartment of an umbrella fund. In this case, subfund is a synonym of investment fund and therefore has the same attributes as investment fund.

EndOfFiscalYear.name: End Of Fiscal Year
EndOfFiscalYear.definition: Date at which the books are closed and profit and loss is determined.

AccountingYearEndDate.name: Accounting Year End Date
AccountingYearEndDate.definition: Last day of the accounting year for the fund.

FirstAccountingYearEndDate.name: First Accounting Year End Date
FirstAccountingYearEndDate.definition: Last day of the first accounting year for the fund.

AuthorisedCountry.name: Authorised Country
AuthorisedCountry.definition: Country in which it is authorised to commercialise the fund.

DomicileCountry.name: Domicile Country
DomicileCountry.definition: Country in which the investment fund is domiciled.

OrderDesk.name: Order Desk
OrderDesk.definition: Entity appointed by the fund, to which orders should be submitted.

TreasuryTradingParty.name: Treasury Trading Party
TreasuryTradingParty.definition: Party which executes a treasury trade on behalf of an investment fund.

Custodian.name: Custodian
Custodian.definition: Party which settles the trades for the account of the fund.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to an investment fund and played by a party in that context.

Family.name: Family
Family.definition: Family to which the investment fund belongs.

UmbrellaFund.name: Umbrella Fund
UmbrellaFund.definition: Umbrella fund for which compartments are specified.
